phase: offline screening, all samples tuning; fresh holdout and human review required for adoption

jpeg.encoder: ImagePet CLI advanced mozjpeg, original Core snapshot abd637e

png.quantizer: Pillow FASTOCTREE, no dithering; exploration only, not pngdeer's quantizer
png.maximum_encodes: 3 quantized candidates plus 1 current PNG baseline

metrics: full-size ImageIO oriented sRGB premultiplied RGBA; existing SSIM proxy, not SSIMULACRA2; not visual acceptance
timing: encoding and scoring both counted; SSIM subprocess RSS measured independently, not hidden in compression timing; repeat each candidate 3 times

adoption_gates.real_asset_extra_savings: >=5% in this screening and a fresh holdout
adoption_gates.human_review: required: text, gradients, edges, transparency; no new automatic lossy PNG without opt-in

fallback: Retain the current format-specific result/original when no smaller candidate passes. Baseline below threshold is retained, not relabeled as passing.
scope: No production dependencies or product defaults change; a failed gate stops adoption of this candidate, not all possible future algorithms.
selection: First 3 eligible PNG inputs per category in manifest order; <=1MP. JPEG excludes nonopaque images; PNG/WebP include alpha. All tuning.

webp.alpha: include alpha, score on black and white

protocol_note: Consolidated reproduction protocol. Exact pre-run JPEG/PNG and WebP protocols are preserved in quality-search-results.json runs.
